subject: Draft Charter Review
overview: The Medford Charter Study Committee reviewed draft charter provisions with consultants from the Collins Center. Members voted to require annual financial disclosure statements in the charter and approved several amendments to Articles 1 through 3 while rejecting special elections and acting mayor roles for department heads.

items.title: Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the June 20th meeting.

items.title: Financial Reporting and Ethics Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Approved a proposal to mandate in the charter that the city council enact an ordinance requiring annual financial disclosure statements from elected officials, candidates, and certain city personnel.

items.title: Compensation Advisory Board
items.summary: Voted against embedding a Compensation Advisory Board directly into the charter, opting instead to recommend in the final report that the city council create one by ordinance.

items.title: Draft Charter Review: Article 1 (General Provisions)
items.summary: Approved adding explicit language recognizing the elected school committee's role in overseeing the public schools under Division of Powers.

items.title: Draft Charter Review: Article 2 (Legislative Branch)
items.summary: Approved a two-thirds council vote requirement to remove the city clerk for cause and added a one-year ward residency requirement prior to inauguration, but rejected proposals to rotate council leadership, require appointed ward replacements to reside in the ward, or hold special elections for vacancies.

items.title: Draft Charter Review: Article 3 (Executive Branch)
items.summary: Rejected adding department heads to the list of officials eligible to serve as acting mayor during a vacancy, and reviewed mayoral term limits and veto override mechanics.

items.title: Final Report Subcommittee Update and Future Meetings
items.summary: Noted progress on the committee's final report and scheduled the next meeting for September 5, 2024, to complete the draft charter review.
